messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: streaming.decode tail latency p99 spike detected across us-west-2 pool; error-rate up 4.2% over baseline. Auto-run triage started. Links: <https://infra.metrics/redwood/streams/p99?window=5m>
omar: seeing the same in dashboards, p95 up ~2.8s -> 4.6s, p99s spiking to 12s on some shards. A bunch of streaming requests hit paging eviction.
jess: any recent rollout?
ling: pushed kernel build 'k8-rt-2026-03a' about 12m ago (compile flags: -O3 -ftree-vectorize + trt8 flash-attn patch). landing PR #4821.
omar: that aligns. timeline: deploy -> small p95 bump -> 8m later big tail events. logs show 'kv_pagefault' and 'decode stall: waiting for compilepath'. snippet: ```2026-03-15T19:02:10Z ERROR decode: evict: pagefault 0x7ff..; compilepath queue wait=286ms; trt init 120ms```
jess: can we confirm affected models? is this only streaming (long context) or also short-generation?
omar: primarily streaming/long-context. embedding endpoints unaffected. most hits are hosted-api customers on small instance class (bursting).
sre-oncall: tagging infra. please provide trace IDs for a sample request. also escalate to kernel team - this looks like compilepath/backpressure.
carla: customer impact check — any customer-facing errors? 502s? 504s?
omar: elevated 502s for chunked streaming sessions, about 0.3% of total requests in past 10m. customer sessions seeing stalls and reconnects.
ling: note the compiler flag change added aggressive inlining for attention kernels; probably increased compile time or changed kernel selection path. I can roll forward a quick revert to previous flags but need approval.
jess: mitigation options: 1) route streaming traffic away from nodes with new kernel; 2) fallback to older model variant that uses CPU decode path or smaller KV cache; 3) rollback kernel build. Fastest is routing. Omar can we switch routing?
omar: yes — we can update routing policy to prefer 'compat' pool. Command: ```rwctl route update --pool us-west-2-standard --prefer compat-pool --selector streaming=true --drain-grace 30s``` planning to run now.
engmgr: go ahead with routing and notify customers if impact >0.5% errors. open incident ticket and set sev=2.
sre-oncall: also please disable the ongoing kernel rollout across other zones until we root-cause. Ling can you pause CI/CD job?
ling: pausing rollout now. CI job id: ci/kernel-roll-2026-03-15-12. pausing... done.
carla: Omar/Jess — after routing change, can we measure p95/p99 delta and document traces? need to know if routing fixes tail.
omar: routing change applied -> patched traffic 18s ago. initial numbers: p95 down 1.4s, p99 down ~6s. error-rate dropped to 1.1%. collecting traces: sample ids: trace-7c9a, trace-7c9b, trace-7c9c. uploading to incident repo.
jess: nice. next steps: 1) keep routing until kernel revert or patch, 2) collect compile logs from kernel pods, 3) engage TRT/flash-attn maintainer to confirm changed heuristics.
ling: I grabbed compile logs: some kernel builds report increased linker time and more frequent fallback to interpreter for flash-attn kernels. suspect optimizer reordering + LTO interaction. attaching excerpt: ```[linker] unresolved symbol __flash_attn_fast; fallback to generic attention kernel; compile_time=420ms (was ~120ms)```
sre-oncall: that's consistent with queueing. if compile_time jumps, decode threads pile up causing KV cache eviction -> pagefaults downstream. Good find.
carla: customer comms: drafting note for affected customers mentioning transient streaming stalls and mitigation in progress. Will wait for eng confirmation before send.
engmgr: decision meeting in 10m: rollback kernel or update compile flags? Ling, what's complexity/time for a revert?
ling: revert to previous kernel build is straightforward — re-promote artifact k8-rt-2026-02z. takes ~6-8 minutes to roll per zone; total ~20-25m for us-west cluster. downside: loses other small fixes.
omar: we can keep routing until revert completes. I'll coordinate the roll.
jess: also add temporary rate limit for long-context streaming to reduce pressure: ```rwctl quota update --route streaming.long --p95 20r/s```
sre-oncall: agreed, apply quota throttling for 30m. track customer errors.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-78, Sev 2. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-tail>. Current status: routing applied, rollout paused, revert queued.
carla: prepping CS note. will include traces and ETA ~25m. cc @support-escalations.
ling: starting revert now: promoting artifact k8-rt-2026-02z -> executing roll command. progress logs: 3/7 nodes updated.
omar: monitoring p99 during roll: good signal — p99 trending down. keep an eye on streaming tail and pagefault metric.
jess: leaving small playbook for postmortem: capture kernel compile logs, diff compiler flags, repro job with long context profile, and perf counters.
engmgr: thank you. once revert completes and metrics stable for 20m, we can downgrade to sev3 and write up action items. good job team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Update: revert completed at 4521790580. Metrics: p95 back to baseline, p99 within 10% of baseline. Incident remains open for postmortem.
carla: CS note sent to affected accounts.
sre-oncall: i'll collect all traces and artifacts, tagging kernel team for postmortem. Please add any additional logs to INC-2026-0315-78.
ling: filing PR to adjust compile flags and add canary test for long-context streaming. PR #4840.
omar: closing operational loop here. we'll keep the incident open for 72h for monitoring.
ops-bot: Incident update logged. END THREAD.
